_comment: What a deploy imports and publishes. Read by apply_env.py (local Docker) and by n8n/deploy/release.mjs (the container image's release step). Console Alerts (SEOagentConsole1) is imported always and published only when SEO_IMAP_PASSWORD is set; the test runner and the callback receiver are never deployed. The Cycle Dispatcher (SEOagentCycleDsp) is published by every deploy (F-ENG 2026-10-20): an import deactivates it, and left inactive no website's week runs. Publishing starts nothing by itself: the seo_cache row cycle:mode (missing = plan_only) is the safety switch the owner flips; the Schedule Catch-up's watchdog alerts when the dispatcher is inactive or has not swept for 20 minutes.
